description: This file defines models and classes for invoice line management and notification messages within an Odoo (OpenERP) module, including custom fields, methods for handling invoice lines, and class inheritance.

classes.name: notify_message
classes.description: Model for notification messages with title and message content.

classes.name: account_invoice_line
classes.description: Model extending invoice line with custom fields, view logic, and behavior based on line type.

classes.name: one2many_mod2
classes.description: Custom one2many field class with specialized get method filtering 'article' state records.

classes.name: account_invoice
classes.description: Invoice model extending default with custom copy behavior and related invoice line fields.

methods.name: move_line_get_item
methods.description: Returns move line item if line state is 'article'.

methods.name: fields_get
methods.description: Defines field properties and states for invoice lines.

methods.name: _onchange_invoice_line_view
methods.description: Handles onchange event for invoice line view, resetting fields based on type.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Overrides create to set default values based on 'state'.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overrides write to reset fields when 'state' changes.

methods.name: _fnct
methods.description: Computes display string for invoice line based on 'state'.

methods.name: _default_account
methods.description: Fetches default account ID where parent_id is NULL.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Custom get method for one2many field, filtering 'article' state records.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Overrides copy method for invoice to reset invoice lines.
